jordan p: Quick heads-up — Marta (intl hire) can't make kiosk on Day 1 (passport renewal appointment fell through). Needs remote I-9 / notary option. Can we coordinate?
maya: thanks jordan. do we have a notary vendor on the books? @onboarding-bot?
onboarding-bot: Notary partners: Notarize, NotaryCam. To request, DM @maya with name + timezone. I-9 status: background check complete, I-9 = pending.
maya: ok i'll book Notarize tomorrow 10:30 PT slot. Jordan can you add Marta to day1 calendar remote link and mark as 'remote I-9'?
jordan p: added calendar invite w/ Zoom link and 'remote I-9' in title. Also pinged IT to confirm laptop shipping address.
it-support: noted — holding laptop dispatch until address confirmation. @marta s can you confirm shipping address in the form?
marta s: confirmed address: 12 Grove St, Apt 4, Vancouver, BC V6B 2Y1. Passport scan uploaded to the onboarding portal (file name passport_vancouver_redacted.jpg). I can do 10:30 PT Notarize.
maya: great. steps for Notarize — copy for record:
```
1. Accept Notarize email invite.
2. Join video notary session with passport + ID.
3. Sign I-9 form in session.
4. Upload session confirmation to onboarding portal.
```
maya: @jordan will you mark Day-1 orientation attendance as 'virtual' and add a 30m block after orientation for any paperwork?
jordan p: done. added 30m buffer at 11:30 PT and updated orientation agenda. Also set fallback: if notary fails, schedule in-person kiosk within 3 business days.
talent-ops: FYI payroll/time entries require completed I-9 before first paycheck. pinging payroll to prep.
payroll-bot: Payroll note recorded — hold first paycheck processing until I-9 completed per policy.
marta s: thanks all. one Q: do I need to bring social security stuff if I'm non-resident? i'm on a work permit.
maya: good Q — bring passport + work permit. SSN not required for I-9 at time of hire if you don't have one; payroll will need SSN later but it's separate.
jordan p: ok closing loop — orientation remains virtual, remote notary at 10:30 PT, IT holds laptop until address confirmed. I'll follow up w/ a short checklist in DM. :thumbsup:
